automatic: Primary phone language ar -> Arabic/RTL; every other primary language -> English/LTR, even if Arabic is secondary
manual: Guest and signed-in Account language selector; Phone language, Arabic, English; persisted per app/store; serial writes preserve the last choice
legacy_designs: Native locale/direction no longer pinned by old identity or STORE_LOCALE; the same approved Home design hydrates in either supported language
preview: Editor identity remains a phone-language simulation; manual preview choices never write native preferences or merchant design
scope: Shared builder app source for WooCommerce, Shopify and Odoo; no merchant IDs or store-specific conditions

tests.ios_localization_manifest: valid plist; en and ar declared

limitations: Installed apps require a new build/update to receive runtime code changes.
Merchant product names, categories and custom copy remain as supplied by the store; no automatic translation is invented.
No physical iOS-device execution in this Windows environment.
